title: Vintage Green Oval Crystal & White Enamel Ring
storyHtml:
A vivid green oval framed by bands of white enamel and tiny pavé crystals — a ring with the poise of a vintage heirloom and the colour of something new. Made to be noticed.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Oval-cut 5A green zircon, pavé clear zircon & white enamel
